Maya (Support): FYI opening triage for TKT-4321 — customer reports issues when using streaming chat + function-calls + structured JSON output. partial function call events, sometimes duplicates. attaching customer notes below.

Ethan (Sales): +1 Acme (enterprise) escalated. they need deterministic ordering and partial-progress events for a live assistant. said they'd consider a paid pilot if we can guarantee behavior. :eyes:

Priya (PM): thanks. can someone paste a minimal repro and a clear acceptance criteria? we should decide scope: bugfix vs feature.

Maya (Support): copied from ticket:
```
Customer stream shows: event sequence -> text.delta, text.delta, function_call.start, function_call.delta, function_call.delta, text.delta (again), function_call.end missing on connection close. sometimes we see the function_call emitted twice with same payload. SDK shows onMessage callbacks: 3x for same call.
Sample header: X-Request-ID: acme-req-888
API: /v1/chat/stream?functions=true&structured=true
```

Liam (Eng): interesting. could be two separate issues: (1) streaming framing for interleaved function_call vs text deltas, (2) duplicate emission from our broker retry/backpressure logic. quick hypothesis: when agents reconnect during long sessions we replay partial frames. need logs (broker+runtime) for that X-Request-ID.

Sofia (DevEx): also want to know which SDKs (node/python) customer used and whether they used the new streaming framing (chunked JSON). if it's our SDK causing duplicate callbacks we can hotfix faster.

Priya (PM): proposal for triage:
- Goal: define minimal product behavior we guarantee for streaming + function-calls + structured output (ordering, idempotency, partial-progress markers).
- Priority: propose P2 (customer impacted, willing to pilot, not platform outage).
- Scope options: 
  A) Narrow fix: address duplicate callbacks in SDK + broker dedupe (2w).
  B) Medium: add explicit framing events for function_call.start/partial/end and a 'finalized' marker in protocol + SDK contract (4w).
  C) Wide: durable replay + ordered delivery guarantee across reconnects (quarter-level).

Ethan (Sales): Acme will accept B if we can ship a pilot in ~4 weeks. they'd sign a pilot SLA for dedicated capacity.

Liam (Eng): rough dev estimate: A=1 week infra/SDK patch + 1 week QA. B=2w infra + 1w API changes + 1w SDK + 1w QA = ~5w. C = much larger.

Maya (Support): acceptance criteria suggestion for option B (customer-facing):
- Streaming contract includes explicit events: function_call.start, function_call.fragment, function_call.end, and stream.finalized.
- SDKs expose single high-level callback per logical function call (no duplicates).
- Backwards compatible: old clients continue to receive raw deltas if not opting in.
- E2E test in CI using long-running example provided by Acme.

Sofia (DevEx): docs checklist: public API update, SDK changelog, migration guide + sample code for partial function calls. Also small example showing how to resume after reconnect.

Priya (PM): launch criteria (for pilot):
- Engineering sign-off on infra and protocol changes
- SDKs (node/python) release candidate + integration tests
- Internal alpha with Acme on dedicated pool + monitoring dashboard panel (function call counts, duplicates, latencies)
- Support runbook for debugging duplicates and steps to enable pilot

Liam (Eng): I'll spike logs for X-Request-ID and add a small repro harness. ETA: spike by EOD tomorrow.

Ethan (Sales): I'll confirm Acme's willingness to sign pilot SLA and budget.

Maya (Support): added ticket link: https://redwood.example/tickets/TKT-4321 (ticket-bot attached)

ticket-bot: Ticket TKT-4321 updated: customer provided full trace attachment.

Priya (PM): next steps / owners: 
- Liam: infra/repro spike (owner)
- Sofia: verify SDK usage & create minimal repro wrappers (owner)
- Maya: collect full request/response stream and confirm versions (owner)
- Ethan: commercial OK for pilot (owner)

Can we reconvene in 48h with spike results? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Liam (Eng): yes 48h works.

Sofia (DevEx): I'll draft the SDK contract proposal and a short migration note by tomorrow. :memo:

Priya (PM): marking P2 for now. I'll create a product backlog ticket with this scope proposal and the acceptance criteria. assigned to Eng team after spike. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Support): thanks everyone. I'll update the customer with expected timeline and escalate if they push for higher priority.

Ethan (Sales): thumbs up. keep me in the loop before any pilot SLA is signed. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
